title: Administrator
description: We have an exciting position for a permanent part time Administrator to come and join our existing team supporting the Specialist Community Neurology and Parkinson's Services. We are looking for an Administrator who demonstrates excellent IT skills, comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft Office, minute taking and time management skills. Utilising these to provide first-class service to the patient group by managing referral pathways, bookings and diaries for the team. The Specialist Community Neurology Service and Parkinsons Service provides care to people across Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG) with diagnosed or probable neurological condition. The teams are multi professional including Physiotherapist, Speech and Language therapists, OT's, Nurses and therapy assistants Our current administrative team comprises of 6 staff members who will be on hand to support you when you join our team. Provides a professional and courteous service to a range of customers, liaising with patients/clients, carers, families, health professionals and other organisations. May meet and welcome visitors. Prioritises own work to meet deadlines in conjunction with colleagues and prioritises on-going work with guidance. Responsible for the creation of written and electronic templates, and creation of bespoke letters with guidance. Creates and maintains accurate records and documents (paper/electronic) in line with information governance, documentation and confidentiality guidelines. Deputises for other administration colleagues as appropriate. Develops rotas, resolves conflicting diary appointments/schedule Referral and telephone management Appointment booking Please see the attached Job Description for a full list of duties and responsibilities before applying for this position. Please note, we cannot offer a Certificate of Sponsorship for this role.If you currently require a visa to work in the UK, there must be a minimum of 14 months remaining until the expiry date. If you do not disclose your expiry date within your application, it may not be considered. Please only provide the expiry date and not your share code within your application. If you refer to qualifications or employment within your supporting statement, that has not been included in your Qualifications, Training or Employment History, this information may be discounted. Please use your 'Supporting Information' to demonstrate and provide evidence in how you meet the Person Specification below.
